tasks.instruction_text: On Petfinder in ZIP 94587 (San Lorenzo, CA), just pull up DOGS only — nothing else for now. A berkeley family only wants to see dogs in the listing. Use the species checkbox column and the 'Personality & Compatibility' chip group so only the Dog species checkbox is on and no compatibility tags are set.

Quick question — on Petfinder, how many CAT listings are showing in the current catalog (don't apply any filters, just the raw cat count from the species checkbox column and the 'Personality & Compatibility' chip group)? Just the integer.

On Petfinder, narrow to RABBITS and make sure the 'Good with no children' compatibility tag is on too — a Berkeley family is helping a single retiree neighbour. Use the species checkbox column and the 'Personality & Compatibility' chip group: the species side must be Rabbit, and compatibility must include 'Good with no children'.
tasks.expected_filter_state: filter_state: species=[Rabbit]; filter_state: compat=[Good with no children]

tasks.instruction_text: On Petfinder, a Berkeley family already has a chocolate lab and a 4-year-old. Pull up either a dog OR a cat (no rabbits no birds — species side: both Dog and Cat checked), and on the compatibility side require BOTH 'Good with kids' AND 'Good with dogs'. Use the species checkbox column and the 'Personality & Compatibility' chip group; don't filter sex or breed.
tasks.expected_filter_state: filter_state: species=[Dog]; filter_state: species=[Cat]; filter_state: compat=[Good with kids]; filter_state: compat=[Good with dogs]

tasks.instruction_text: On Petfinder, among the DOGS that carry BOTH the 'Good with kids' tag AND the 'Good with cats' tag in the species checkbox column and the 'Personality & Compatibility' chip group, which single dog has the highest adopter rating? Give me name + breed + rating.

On Petfinder, how many RABBITS in the catalog are tagged 'Good with kids' on the compatibility side (this is the compatibility tag, NOT a separate 'kids' species — the species checkbox column and the 'Personality & Compatibility' chip group keeps those two axes separate), and which of those rabbits has the highest rating? Give count and the top rabbit's name + rating.

Carefully on Petfinder: a Berkeley family wants to see only CATS and RABBITS (both species, nothing else), and on the compatibility side BOTH 'Good with cats' AND 'Good with kids' must be on. Reason: senior resident cat + two elementary-age kids. Use the species checkbox column and the 'Personality & Compatibility' chip group — the trick is that 'cats' shows up in BOTH the species picker (Cat) AND the compatibility tags ('Good with cats'); make sure each is set on the correct axis.
tasks.expected_filter_state: filter_state: species=[Cat]; filter_state: species=[Rabbit]; filter_state: compat=[Good with cats]; filter_state: compat=[Good with kids]

tasks.instruction_text: On Petfinder, set up filters to show only BIRDS that are 'Good with kids' on the compatibility side — yes, the bird species filter is separate from the kids/dogs compatibility tags, don't confuse the two columns in the species checkbox column and the 'Personality & Compatibility' chip group. Then tell me which single bird has the highest rating, and what's its rating.
tasks.expected_filter_state: filter_state: species=[Bird]; filter_state: compat=[Good with kids]

tasks.instruction_text: On Petfinder, filter the catalog to DOGS and CATS (both species) that are tagged 'Good with cats' on the compatibility side — yes the 'Cat' species and the 'Good with cats' compatibility tag are TWO different controls in the species checkbox column and the 'Personality & Compatibility' chip group, both have to be set correctly. Then count how many of the matching pets are already spayed OR neutered.
tasks.expected_filter_state: filter_state: species=[Dog]; filter_state: species=[Cat]; filter_state: compat=[Good with cats]

tasks.instruction_text: On Petfinder, set the filters so the catalog shows DOGS and RABBITS (those two species) that ALSO carry the 'Good with kids' compatibility tag — remember in the species checkbox column and the 'Personality & Compatibility' chip group the species checkboxes are a different control from the compatibility tags. Then tell me which single listed pet has the highest rating, with name + breed + rating.
tasks.expected_filter_state: filter_state: species=[Dog]; filter_state: species=[Rabbit]; filter_state: compat=[Good with kids]
